en: Hey there, $c! Looks like the Horde collected the last of their stuff, and now theirs and ours is being shipped over to Silithus as we speak. I'm told it'll be there in less than a day, and then someone can ring that big gong near the Ahn'Qiraj gates to start the war.
I wish to purchase arcane quickener from you.

Neither you nor I could possibly imagine the pain an individual suffers when their soul is ripped from their body. They are not dead and by no means are they alive. Instead, they walk the land, servants of those that bind them to this world.$B$BLord Razelikh, demonic overlord of these lands, enslaved them all. Nine he took for his own, placing stones of binding near the Dark Portal. The remaining nine were divided up between his subordinates.
Surely Mot didn't send you to me? He knows better. You are not yet capable of understanding what I would teach you. See my son Mot, just outside there, and finish training with him.

Tucked away in the Mage Quarter, there is a little shop called Alchemy Needs.  You're bound to see all sort of strange shops on your way through the Mage Quarter, but if you stick to the outer rim you'll be sure to find it.
Where is it ye would like to go $g lad : lass;? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.
Even demons are capable of fear...
I have a great deal of work to do.  Are you here to aid me with my research?
The Coldtooth Mine is owned by the Alliance.
%s notes your cowardly battle tactics and flees from battle.
HEY! HEY YOU! $R! Get me out of here!
You've got something I need, Astor. And I'll be taking it now.
Listen carefully, $n, for I have much knowledge to impart.
There is no hope!
Elder Proudhorn is enjoying the vistas above Mulgore at Thunder Bluff.
I caught a big one last week, it had three eyes!
I need another set of tools.
%s siphons the energy from the totem and redirects it in the form of an anti-magic pulse.
BY FIRE BE PURGED!
|cffffff00Eastwall Tower has been taken by the Horde!|r
Scream your dying breath!
Not bad, for a beginner! I guess it couldn't hurt for me to show you a few things...
Where is Elder Skychaser?
What can you teach me?

I dream, $n... oh yes, I dream. In my dreams I die a thousand times in a thousand different ways. Some would call dreams such as mine nightmares. NOT I! In dreams I die in the thick of battle. For each single death of my own, ten thousand enemies of the Horde fall before me. It is glorious!

I don't know how they do it...  those mailboxes must be magic portals or something.  Why I see people gathered around the mailbox next to the bank all day pulling swords and shields and various armor all from that small box!
Bullseye! That blasted dwarf doesn't know what he is talking about. Only thing wrong with Grumlar's gun is Grumlar's aim.
The final sanctum of crazed zealots. 'Tis where they create their scarlet uniforms, magically imbued by the enchanted scarlet thread!$B$BTo Stratholme, adventurer!
%s lets loose a sinister laugh.
You can cook?  So can I!  Is there a recipe you can teach me?
Free drinks at the Blue Recluse!
Raaarrrrggghhh!  We come for you!
Nana always said there was no greater thing in the whole world than a warm, toasty slice of fresh, homemeade cherry pie.
Glorious, indeed, Maltrake. It looks as if my plan worked perfectly. Wouldn't you say so, mortal?
%s disappears into the swamp.
%s breathes a sigh of relief.
Please do as I instruct you, $n.
Train me in the ways of the beast.
Breathe your last!
Make ready for battle, my creations.
The ruins of Dire Maul stand in central Ferelas.
If you touch me again it'll be the last thing you touch!
I'm going back to the Rookery, Tinkee.  I need an Eggscilliscope!
The future holds much death and uncertainty, not unlike the past.
I have payed your price, Gloom'rel.  Now, teach me your secrets!

Those filthy beasts are all over the place.$B$BIf you prefer hunting outdoors, you'll find most of them around Plaguewood and Terrordale, with a good concentration of them in the Terrorweb tunnel. They are also likely to appear at almost any Scourge encampment in the Eastern Plaguelands.$B$BIf you're a hearty dungeon crawler, you'll find a good lot of them in Stratholme and a few of the necrofiend variety in Scholomance.
